_: Known-harmless electron-builder log lines that scripts/build-log-filter.mjs hides from package-remote.sh. Each rule matches a message; with every_dep, it hides the line only when every listed dependency matches that pattern, so a new, real one still shows.

rules.why: Info only: pnpm list --json abbreviates a package it already printed and electron-builder swaps in the full entry. The real problem is 'unresolved duplicate dependency references', which stays visible.
sharp's and esbuild's optional binaries for other platforms; pnpm doesn't install them on a Mac and the arm64 app never loads them.
